import narwhals as nw
import polars as pl

# Create sample DataFrame
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "id": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    "spend": [500, 1500, 800, 1000, 2000]
})

# Convert to narwhals and add tier column
nw_df = nw.from_native(df)
result = nw_df.with_columns(
    tier=nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000)
        .then(nw.lit("gold"))
        .otherwise(nw.lit("standard"))
)

# Convert back to native and display
print(nw.to_native(result))

import narwhals as nw
import polars as pl

# Create sample DataFrame
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "id": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    "spend": [500, 1500, 800, 1000, 2000]
})

result = nw_df.with_columns(
    tier=nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000)

)
